summary: Frontend-only verification of MikiLab v31.0 'Elite Engine & Pure Core'. All 7 requested scenarios PASS. (1) ADMIN: slogan present, exactly 3 macro-area buttons (elite-room-panetteria/pizzeria/pasticceria), all 5 OLD room testids (impasti/forni/laugen/banco/pretzel) are GONE, area switching works (titles change to PIZZERIA/PASTICCERIA/PANETTERIA), elite-capo-panel present, no locked badge. (2) Pannello Capo: elite-capo-solo/elite-capo-squadra toggle works, persists to localStorage mikilab_work_mode ('solo'/'squadra'), crew list hidden in solo and elite-capo-crew shows 2 seeded workers in squadra ('Operatore Forni · Panetteria', 'Sostituto Test · Pizzeria · Sostituto'). (3) Modalita Ferie: elite-holiday-toggle -> POST /api/lab/holiday persists {active:true}, elite-holiday-banner appears, braccio-holiday-banner appears in the operative lab ('Lab on holiday - production paused'); toggled back OFF and verified GET /api/lab/holiday = {active:false} (state left CLEAN). (4) Allarme Forno Prioritario verified END-TO-END: selected the 2-min DB recipe 'Pizza Napoletana (tonda)', elite-timer bound to recipe (2:00, 450C), elite-start-bake enabled and started countdown, at 0:00 elite-alarm-priority + elite-alarm-ack appeared, ACK cleared the alarm and restored elite-start-bake. (5) OPERATORE (dept forni): clean lab (braccio-quick-banco/aggiungi absent), engine has 0 elite-room-* buttons, elite-locked-dept present and forced to PANETTERIA, no elite-capo-panel. (6) SOSTITUTO: braccio-sostituto-countdown present and ticking (07:55:09 -> 07:55:06), clean operator view, engine locked to PIZZERIA, no capo panel. (7) GUEST (401 on /api/auth/me): elite-guest-badge present, elite-input-kg disabled, elite-start-bake disabled (click times out / timer stays 22:00), 3 room buttons still browsable (switched to PASTICCERIA). Backend gating re-confirmed via curl: POST /api/lab/holiday and GET /api/operator/crew = 401 guest / 403 operatore.

ui_bugs.issue: braccio-holiday-banner does not refresh when Modalita Ferie is toggled from inside the Elite Engine: GET /api/lab/holiday is fetched only on mount, so after closing the overlay the lab banner is stale until a page reload. Lift the holiday state (or refetch on overlay close / via a callback from the engine).

integration_issues.issue: toggleHoliday() optimistically sets local state BEFORE awaiting POST /api/lab/holiday and swallows all errors (try/catch empty, no response.ok check). If the request fails (session expired / 403) the Capo sees a false 'ferie ON' state. Not user-visible today because the toggle is only rendered for isCapo, but it is a silent-failure pattern.

issues: The Elite Engine keeps its OWN language state (default it-IT) that is not synced with the app LanguageContext: with the app rendering in EN, elite-slogan, elite-locked-dept ('Reparto assegnato'), the Capo panel and the alarm text all render in Italian. Initialise the engine language from useLang() so labels stay consistent.
Room/area titles and the alarm copy are hardcoded Italian strings (rooms3D.title, 'ALLARME FORNO - sfornare!') while the rest of the engine is multi-language.

action_items: LOW: refresh braccio-holiday-banner after the holiday toggle (lift holiday state or refetch on Elite Engine close) so the lab banner is not stale until reload
LOW: make toggleHoliday await/verify the POST (check res.ok) and revert local state + toast on failure instead of silently succeeding
LOW: sync MikiLabEliteEngine language with the app LanguageContext (slogan/locked badge/capo panel currently Italian while UI is EN); make rooms3D.title and the alarm copy translatable
critical_code_review_comments: MikiLabEliteEngine.jsx is 638 lines mixing rooms3D data, radio, oven timer, Capo panel and legal modals - extract rooms3D + the oven/alarm logic into separate modules/hooks

The alarm escalation setTimeout(120s) -> POST /api/oven/alarm only survives while the overlay is mounted (cleared in the !open effect), so an operator who closes the engine silently cancels the escalation to the Capo - consider server-side scheduling or persisting the pending alarm
MikiLabEliteEngine crew fetch and holiday fetch have no loading/error UI (both .catch(() => {})): a failed GET /api/operator/crew is indistinguishable from an empty crew ('Nessun operaio ancora')

BraccioLab operatorApi.getProfile().catch(() => {}) still has no error state; the lock is now fail-closed (isLocked = locked) which is correct, but the badge will show 'Reparto non ancora assegnato' for a transient network error

context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything in the v31.0 request is verified. Useful recipes: 'Pizza Napoletana (tonda)' has bake_minutes=2, so selecting it in elite-db-recipe-select lets you reach the elite-alarm-priority/elite-alarm-ack state in ~2 minutes of real waiting (verified).
